items.summary: PR #171 (#170) MERGED — TakeAction resolved-action event contract (v1alpha2)
items.details: Beat-1 of TakeAction wave (Chapter 2). Merged 2026-06-01 as main 63c1d93, released v0.1.100. Added to dnd5e/api/v1alpha2/encounter: correlation_id (string, tag 3) on EncounterEvent envelope (Inv 8 causation); ActionResolved (tag 27, umbrella: actor_entity_id, Ref action_ref, target_entity_id, EconomyConsumed) + nested EconomyConsumed{actions,bonus_actions,reactions,movement,granted_consumed map}; AttackResolved (tag 28: attacker_entity_id,target_entity_id,hit,critical,attack_roll,attack_bonus,target_ac — fires on MISS, the #594 fix, D9 ErrUnknownEventType unblock); TurnStateChanged (tag 45, push refresh, full recomputed TurnState — kept OFF ActionResolved on the audience seam Inv 6); EconomySlot + TargetKind enums + economy_slot(5)/target_kind(6) on AvailableAction. Refs carry toolkit's TWO native namespaces verbatim (combat_abilities:* intent + actions:* doing), NOT flattened (flattening = Inv-2 rules remap). action_ref is a Ref/triple on the wire; api splits the module:type:id string at translate. TargetKind = {UNSPECIFIED,SELF,SINGLE_ENTITY,POSITION,AREA,NONE} — NONE!=SELF (Dodge=SELF self-buff; Dash=NONE targets nothing); proto mirrors toolkit's 6-value enum 1:1 for field-for-field projection. Entity-id wire fields follow v1alpha2 <role>_entity_id convention (not toolkit struct's bare _id). Contract converged peer-to-peer with toolkit expert; director-signed-off D13; landed FIRST in D9 pipeline. Doc: added v1alpha2 TakeAction section to docs/architecture/components/encounter-service.md.

items.summary: Ref.type example comment fix (types.proto Ref) — PR #172 MERGED
items.details: dnd5e/api/v1alpha2/encounter/types.proto — the canonical Ref message's `type` examples listed only the old single "action" namespace, self-contradictory with the same file's AvailableAction.ref comment (combat_abilities) after #171. One-source-of-truth-for-shape drift, comment-only/zero-wire-impact. Surfaced by team-lead's independent review gate on #171 (non-blocking). Fixed + MERGED via PR #172 (Part of #54) 2026-06-01: examples now combat_abilities/actions + a no-flatten note; canonical Ref doc is self-consistent. NOTE for future: an automated comment-only checker false-positives on a `field = N;` line when only its trailing inline `//` comment changes (the whole line reads as changed though the field is byte-identical) — eyeball confirms comment-only.

items.summary: Issue #138 — collapse dual state shapes in EncounterService
items.details: EncounterStateData (encounter.proto:96) coexists with legacy fragmented fields in GetEncounterStateResponse (line 353-382). CharacterCombatState, MonsterCombatState, EntityPlacement still defined and populated. Per Rule 1 (one source of truth for shape) — violation. Fix requires consumer migration in rpg-api / rpg-dnd5e-web first, then a proto PR that removes the legacy fields with `reserved`. ChoiceSubmission dual selection paths (selection_ids vs deprecated oneof) bundled in this issue.

items.summary: Issue #139 — make `buf breaking` blocking in CI
items.details: .github/workflows/ci.yml:31 has `continue-on-error: true` on the buf breaking step. Per Rule 2 — the contract layer must enforce its own contract. One-line fix: remove that line. Highest-leverage fix on the board.

sandbox/api/v1alpha1 (315 lines, both files) + 4 unused api/v1alpha1 services (room_environments.proto 530, room_spatial.proto 1064, room_spawn.proto 1424, room_selectables.proto 1821) + 4 deprecated EncounterService RPCs (Attack, MoveCharacter, DungeonStart, GetCombatState) + deprecated fields (TurnState 5 fields, Proficiencies 2, DamageComponent.source). Per Rule 4 — no proto unused for >1 release. Coordinate with rpg-api: delete services/sandboxroom/types.go interface stub at the same time. Will fail buf breaking (expected); land after #139 with explicit waiver, or before.

Per rpg-project/ideas/coordinate-types/design.md, api.v1alpha1.Position will move from double X/Y/Z to int32 X/Y/Z. Cube coordinate invariant (X+Y+Z=0) is integer; the current double signature is the root cause of int↔float64 casts that produced 5 coordinate bugs in Round 2 (rpg-api PRs #459, #461, #463, #466, #467). Breaking wire change. Must follow the rpg-api types landing first (per design.md). Likely a v1alpha2 package bump rather than in-place rename.
